description:
ACTIVATION_INPUT_ROW_BUDGET = 8 (semantic.rs ~1012; ActivationInputAlternatives::rebuild joins rows past it). At >=9 same-seed sites it joins rows that are the correct answer (Enumerable.List.reduce/3 with erased closure; Kernel.+/2 turns generic). With the budget unlimited: hand-count keys, no lib test or fixture needs it to terminate, 14 fixtures fire it today (00616, 00642, 00758-00767, 00769, 01024) with identical stdout. Blockers: fz2 run panics at 12 sites in cranelift-jit compiled_blob.rs:225 TryFromIntError(NegOverflow) (fz-2un), and the distiller's largest drive goes 49,760 -> 50,644 (over the 50,000 budget). Report: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/nine/report.md; diffs exp_budget_max.diff, exp_budget_per_publisher.diff.

Re-measure after fz-9zq.1 (2026-11-14): the clash fold gives the evidence row the widening this budget lacks; whether the budget is still needed is measured then.

Evidence (Bugs and Cleanup session, develop 4f8b72ea4; PR #630 fz-3sy.29, .agent/docs/exceptions.md there): Kernel.panic/1 keeps one input row per exception struct raised into it (each non-ground: __exception__: true keys fz_panic/1 as map). At the ninth row the rows join to one union with the literal widened to atom; that union is ground, so probe_keys_as_itself keys fz_panic/1 by it: panic/1 is analysed once more and fz_panic/1 gets a second activation (1-5 extra jobs) in any program raising more than ~7 exception types. Also explains 00420 changed-revision census 1075 -> 1076 across #601. If the budget goes, tests/exception_cost_test.rs bound (extra 1..=5 at 16 and 26 types) should fall to zero.

Evidence for the distiller blocker (Bugs and Cleanup's Fable review for fz-sc8.22.1, 2026-11-23): exact one-column row fusion (fusing rows that differ only in one column's union) took collapses to 0 on 17 of the 20 collapsing fixtures, including 16 that collapse on develop today (e.g. 00758-00769). It is not free: always-on fusion loses definite-error diagnostics. A broken reducer over a non-literal list reports spec/violation without fusion but raises at run time with it. Data: B&C scratchpad s22/review/collapse-table.txt and probes/d1.fz. A 'graded widening at the budget' proposal was dropped as subsumed by this ticket.
title: The 8-row activation input budget is deleted
